# Owned by this repo (NOT synced): the renders in the signed manifests artifact, one per line. The
# release and PR-preview workflows publish them (renders_file) and Manifest diff (synced from
# wshno/devops) reviews them:
#   <out-path>=<deploy-dir>[,<component>]
# out-path is the file in the rendered output/artifact, deploy-dir is kustomize-built, component is an
# optional kustomize Component under deploy-dir. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
adsb/manifests.yaml=deploy/adsb
ais-catcher/manifests.yaml=deploy/ais-catcher
sdr-debug/manifests.yaml=deploy/sdr-debug
